name: Runner Extras - Precompiled TableExt Keys
brief: Issue #3216: the keys a tableextension declares must reach the extended table's key list when the tableextension arrives as a PRECOMPILED dependency .app, not just when the runner compiles it from AL source.
description: Runner-mechanism claim, not a claim about AL. That a tableextension's keys are part of the extended table's key list is plain BC behaviour and is pinned upstream in the al-language corpus (codeunit 60331) — but every corpus bundle is source-compiled by the runner, so the corpus can only ever exercise the AL-SOURCE reader. This bundle exercises the other reader: BcAppSymbolCache's parse of a dependency package's SymbolReference.json. Without it, a renamed JSON property or a dropped argument at the MergeExtensionFields call site in RecordPatches.BcAppFallback.cs would return zero keys from the precompiled path and every corpus test would still pass. The dependency's third declared key names a field nothing declares; asserting the exact key COUNT is what makes the drop-it-whole rule observable, since that branch reports itself to stderr only.
